официальность.второй_признак: подвал страницы "©2026 Google" + ссылки Privacy Policy/Terms of Service; текст справки Gemini Apps от лица Google ("Info by Google LLC" как пример подписи). Строка Copyright Google LLC в html есть только внутри встроенного JS, не как признак страницы.

картина: Справочная статья Gemini Apps Help (вариант 'Computer') для конечных пользователей приложения Gemini: как проверить, создана ли/отредактирована ли картинка, видео или аудио ИИ. Модели генерации не названы (только 'Google's AI models'/'Google AI tools'). Структура: вступление (две технологии: SynthID и Content Credentials), What you need, Upload your content (лимиты файла, приём кропа скриншота, шаги загрузки, вопросы-примеры), About the verification results (SynthID / Content Credentials), Other ways to identify AI-generated content (визуальные артефакты, обратный поиск, метаданные), FAQ по SynthID (устойчивость знака, водяной знак vs метаданные, квота 10 проверок/24ч), FAQ по Content Credentials (C2PA, что делают/не делают, ошибки: изменено, несовместимо — версии 2.2+, нераспознано). Собственные термины: SynthID, Content Credentials, C2PA, 'digital passport', 'Not enough details to watermark', 'Likely too small an edit'. Повторяется формула 'created or edited'. Дата публикации/обновления не найдена ни в тексте, ни в html.

единицы.утверждение_en: Signed-in users can use the verification tool within the Gemini App to help identify images, videos, and audio generated or edited by AI models.
единицы.цитата: You can use the verification tool available within the Gemini App for signed-in users, to help identify images, videos, and audio generated or edited by AI models.
единицы.раздел: Verify AI-generated images, videos, and audio

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID uses invisible watermarks to determine if images, videos, and audio were generated or edited specifically by Google's AI models.
единицы.цитата:
SynthID:
Uses invisible watermarks to determine if images, videos, and audio were generated or edited specifically by Google's AI models.
единицы.раздел: Verify AI-generated images, videos, and audio
единицы.заметка: Одна из двух технологий проверки. Модели генерации не названы, только "Google's AI models".

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials act like a digital passport documenting the digital content's origin and history, and are used for both AI and non-AI content.
единицы.цитата:
Content Credentials:
A technology that acts like a digital passport, documenting the digital content's origin and history, and is used for both AI and non-AI content.
единицы.раздел: Verify AI-generated images, videos, and audio

единицы.утверждение_en: Verification with Content Credentials is available at gemini.google.com and in the Gemini app for Android; it will be available in the Gemini app for iOS soon.
единицы.цитата:
Verification with Content Credentials is available at
gemini.google.com
and in the Gemini app for Android.  It will be available in the Gemini app for iOS soon.
единицы.раздел: Verify AI-generated images, videos, and audio
единицы.заметка: Состояние на момент страницы, даты нет.

единицы.утверждение_en: To use AI verification you need a personal account or qualified Workspace account, the latest version of the Gemini App if you use the app, and to be signed in to Gemini Apps.
единицы.цитата:
To use AI verification, you need:
A personal account or qualified Workspace account
The latest version of the Gemini App if you use the app to verify content.
To be signed in to Gemini Apps.

единицы.утверждение_en: Only a single image, video, or audio file can be chosen for verification at a time, and it should have a file size of 100 MB or less.
единицы.цитата: You can only choose a single image, video, or audio file to verify at a time, and it should have a file size of 100 MB or less.

единицы.утверждение_en: Videos to verify need to be less than 90 seconds each and audio files less than 1 hour each.
единицы.цитата: Videos need to be less than 90 seconds each, and audio files need to be less than 1 hour each
единицы.заметка: Не про картинки (видео/аудио); сохранено, т.к. входит в тот же блок лимитов проверки.

единицы.утверждение_en: When verifying a screenshot of an image, crop tight around the image to get maximum accuracy and don't upload a collage of multiple distinct images.
единицы.цитата: If you're taking a screenshot of an image to verify, make sure to crop tight around the image to get maximum accuracy, and don’t upload a collage of multiple distinct images.

единицы.утверждение_en: On a computer, go to gemini.google.com, click Add files, then upload from device (Upload Files), from Google Photos (More Uploads > Photos), or from Google Drive (Add from Drive).
единицы.цитата:
On your computer, go to
https://gemini.google.com
.
Click Add files
.
To upload a supported file from your device click Upload Files
.
To upload a supported file from Google photos, click
More Uploads
Photos
.
To add a supported file from your Google Drive, click Add from Drive

единицы.утверждение_en: To add files from Drive you need Keep Activity on and Google Workspace connected to Gemini Apps.
единицы.цитата: To add files from your Drive, you need to have Keep Activity on and connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps. If it’s not connected, you'll get the option to connect it.

единицы.утверждение_en: After uploading, ask a verification question such as "Was this image/video/audio created or edited by Google AI?", "Is this AI-generated?" or "Is this a real video?".
единицы.цитата:
Ask a verification question such as:
"Was this image/video/audio created or edited by Google AI?"
"Is this AI-generated?"
"Is this a real video?"
единицы.заметка: Это примеры запросов к Gemini для проверки, не промпты генерации картинок; поэтому вид "инструкция", а не пример_промпта.

единицы.утверждение_en: Although other companies have started to adopt SynthID watermarks, Gemini can currently only recognize content created by Google AI tools.
единицы.цитата: While other companies have started to adopt SynthID watermarks, Gemini can currently only recognize content created by Google AI tools.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials can provide info about the origin and history of content and whether AI tools were used to create or edit it.
единицы.цитата: Content Credentials can help provide info about origin and history of content and whether AI tools were used to create or edit it.

единицы.утверждение_en: If a SynthID watermark is detected, all or part of the image or video was created or edited by Google's AI models.
единицы.цитата: If a SynthID watermark is detected, it means all or part of the image or video was created or edited by Google's AI models.
единицы.заметка: Важно: водяной знак ставится и на отредактированные ИИ Google части.

единицы.утверждение_en: If a SynthID watermark isn't detected, the image or video wasn't created or edited by Google AI, but it could have been created by other AI systems.
единицы.цитата: If a SynthID watermark isn’t detected, it means the image or video wasn’t created or edited by Google AI, but it could have been created by other AI systems.

единицы.утверждение_en: In some cases it isn't clear whether an image or video was created or edited by Google AI; one common reason is "Not enough details to watermark" (e.g., very simple or abstract content).
единицы.цитата:
In some cases it isn’t clear if the image or video was created or edited by Google AI or not. Some common reasons for this are:
"Not enough details to watermark" (e.g., very simple or abstract content).
единицы.заметка: Следствие для генерации: очень простые/абстрактные картинки могут не нести надёжно детектируемый знак.

единицы.утверждение_en: Another common reason for an unclear result is "Likely too small an edit": minor alterations might not carry a detectable watermark.
единицы.цитата: "Likely too small an edit" (minor alterations might not carry a detectable watermark).

единицы.утверждение_en: If content contains Content Credentials, Gemini shows a summary of media composition, edit history, and whether or not AI was used.
единицы.цитата:
If the content contains Content Credentials, you can view a summary of:
Media composition.
Edit history.
Whether or not AI was used.

единицы.утверждение_en: Besides verification in the Gemini app, potentially AI-generated content can be identified by examining images and videos for inconsistencies or errors that are common in AI-generated content.
единицы.цитата:
While content verification in the Gemini app can be a powerful tool, you can also use other methods to identify potentially AI-generated content:
Look for visual artifacts:
Examine images and videos for inconsistencies or errors that are common in AI-generated content. These can include:
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content
единицы.заметка: Список типичных артефактов ИИ-картинок (следующие единицы) полезен генератору как список известных слабых мест для проверки кадра.

единицы.утверждение_en: Inconsistent or garbled text within the image or video is a common error in AI-generated content.
единицы.цитата: Inconsistent or garbled text within the image or video.
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content
единицы.заметка: Как_получено: пункт списка "common in AI-generated content".

единицы.утверждение_en: Errors in small details, such as hands, teeth, or background elements, are common in AI-generated content.
единицы.цитата: Errors in small details, such as hands, teeth, or background elements.
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content

единицы.утверждение_en: Inconsistent shadows and lighting are common in AI-generated content.
единицы.цитата: Inconsistent shadows and lighting.
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content

единицы.утверждение_en: Repetitive patterns that seem unnatural are common in AI-generated content.
единицы.цитата: Repetitive patterns that seem unnatural.
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID embeds digital watermarks directly into content generated by Google's AI models; currently it can verify whether images, videos, or audio were created or edited by Google AI tools.
единицы.цитата: SynthID is a tool that embeds digital watermarks directly into content generated by Google's AI models. Currently, it can be used to verify whether images, videos, or audio files were created or edited by Google AI tools.

единицы.утверждение_en: The SynthID watermark will usually still exist even if the image, video, or audio is re-scaled, re-colored, compressed or altered in other ways.
единицы.цитата: The digital watermark will usually still exist even if the image, video, or audio is re-scaled, re-colored, compressed or altered in other ways.

единицы.утверждение_en: There's still a chance that after many alterations the SynthID watermark won't be detected.
единицы.цитата: However, there's still a chance that after many alterations the watermark won’t be detected.

единицы.утверждение_en: Watermarks are embedded directly into content, are used for verification and are not visible to users; metadata lets content creators add additional context with original files.
единицы.цитата: Watermarks are embedded directly into content and used for verification purposes. The digital watermarks are not visible to users. Metadata allows content creators to add additional context with original files to provide more information about the content. Both watermarks and metadata are used to increase transparency around AI-generated content.

единицы.утверждение_en: There is a usage quota of approximately 10 image checks, 10 video checks (up to 5 minutes total), and 10 audio checks (up to 3 hours total) within any 24-hour rolling window; the Gemini App notifies you when you reach these limits.
единицы.цитата: There’s a usage quota of approximately 10 image checks, 10 video checks (up to 5 minutes total), and 10 audio checks (up to 3 hours total) within any 24-hour rolling window. If you reach these limits, the Gemini App will notify you.
единицы.заметка: Квота проверок, не генераций. "approximately" — число приблизительное.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials provide media history and transparency, including whether AI was involved; it is an industry standard developed by the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) and supported by many products from different companies.
единицы.цитата: are a technology that provides media history and transparency, including whether AI was involved in the creation of the content. It is an industry standard developed by the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA), and is supported by many products from different companies.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials provide details about the origin and history of content through a cross-device, cross-app standard, and information from the app or device maker about AI or non-AI tools used to create or edit a file.
единицы.цитата:
Provide details about the origin and history of content through a standard that works across devices and apps from different companies.
Provide information from the app or device maker about AI or non-AI tools used to create or edit an image, video, or audio file.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials don't tell you if a file is definitely AI-generated; the origin and history information is to be used together with the content itself to make informed decisions.
единицы.цитата: Tell you if an image, video, or audio file is definitely AI-generated, but you can use the origin and history information with the content itself to make informed decisions.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials verification is available for files from devices and apps that support compatible versions of the Content Credentials format.
единицы.цитата: Content Credentials verification is available for image, video, or audio files from devices and apps that support compatible versions of the Content Credentials format.

единицы.утверждение_en: When available, Content Credentials show the company that provided and cryptographically signed the information, e.g. "Info by Google LLC"; the result may list more than one company.
единицы.цитата:
Show the company that provided and cryptographically signed the information. For example, “Info by Google LLC” shows that Google provided the information.
The result may list more than one company.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials are built on history maintained and signed by each editor of the file; if the media history was tampered with or modified without an appropriate update of the C2PA data, an error occurs and the Credentials may be shown as invalid.
единицы.цитата:
If Gemini Apps attempt to verify Content Credentials but there’s an issue, they may display a message saying that the Credentials are invalid. This could be due to these common errors:
Incorrectly modified:
Content Credentials are built on history that’s maintained and signed by each editor of the file. If the media history was tampered with or modified without an appropriate update of the C2PA data, an error occurs.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini Apps support Content Credentials versions 2.2 and later from products on the C2PA Conforming Products List; credentials from products outside that list may not be considered valid or trusted.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini Apps supports Content Credentials versions 2.2 and later, from products on the
C2PA Conforming Products List
. Credentials from products outside that list may not be considered valid or trusted.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini Apps don't support Content Credentials metadata stored remotely, separate from the file.
единицы.цитата: Additionally, some third-party Content Credentials apps store the metadata remotely, separate from the image, video, or audio file; Gemini Apps don’t support remote metadata.

единицы.утверждение_en: A file may contain malformed Content Credentials when the generating app had a bug; Gemini Apps may detect but not interpret them in some cases.
единицы.цитата: A file may contain malformed Content Credentials when the app that generated the file experienced a bug. Gemini Apps may detect the Credentials, but can’t interpret them in some cases.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: The page presents two complementary provenance mechanisms for Google-generated images: SynthID, an invisible watermark in the pixels that usually survives rescaling, recoloring and compression but is recognized only for Google AI, and Content Credentials (C2PA), a signed cross-industry metadata history that becomes invalid if the file is modified without updating the C2PA data.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Связка двух механизмов; цитаты нет — вывод по странице.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: A negative result is weak evidence: simple or abstract images, very small edits and heavily altered files may not show a detectable SynthID watermark, and other companies' watermarks are not recognized.
The page repeatedly frames coverage as 'created or edited', indicating that content only partly edited by Google AI (not just fully generated content) carries the watermark or AI-use record.

противоречия_внутри: Напряжение между E-293-15 (нет знака — значит не создано/не отредактировано Google AI) и E-293-16/E-293-17/E-293-26 (простой контент, малая правка или много изменений могут не дать детектируемого знака): строка 72 звучит категоричнее, чем допускают строки 73-75 и 104.
не_сказано: Не названы конкретные модели генерации (Nano Banana и др.) и не сказано явно, что все их выходы несут SynthID и Content Credentials — только общая формула "content generated by Google's AI models".
Не сказано, можно ли отключить SynthID или Content Credentials при генерации.
Не сказано, сохраняет ли скриншот Content Credentials (дан только совет кропать скриншот для точности, что относится к SynthID-проверке).
Нет ни одного промпта генерации картинок; визуальные артефакты даны как признаки ИИ, без советов, как их избегать в промпте.
Не указано, как отличаются лимиты проверки для подписчиков разных тарифов.
сомнения: В метаданных партии для страницы указаны модели 'Nano Banana', 'SynthID', но слово 'Nano Banana' не найдено ни в .txt, ни в .html (grep).
Даты на странице нет; состояние "iOS soon" без даты.
Страница — вариант справки для платформы Computer; для Android/iPhone шаги могут отличаться (есть переключатель платформ).
